reviews.scope: Frozen SoA8 R1 source; review dispositions, not a benchmark or test-pass receipt.

dispositions.shared_bit_words: Polarity words initialized before publication and never mutated; assignment polarity override stays local.
dispositions.global_lock: Array fill outside registry lock; call_once entered outside registry lock; readers use immutable pointers.
dispositions.same_view_race_and_capacity: Added diagnostic soa_shared_view_oracle_r1.cpp: both polarities, eight workers, bitwise scalar comparison, nonzero charge flips and capacity waiters. Actual pass recorded separately by executor.
dispositions.fallback_and_pages: Native harness requires zero standalone records and all 40,044,615 filtered source points; capacity is 65,535 pages, not unrestricted uint32 points.
dispositions.memory_accounting: 8-byte assignment excludes shared auxiliary arrays: 12 B/source point plus 8.125 B per materialized polarity view, retained source ownership and table/container overhead. Actual peak RSS includes all.
dispositions.null_padding: No forged index is reachable through public constructors; scalar default page serves only index zero. Optional invalid-index padding does not fix arbitrary corrupt offsets and was not added.
dispositions.layout_link_guard: Distinct integral_constant-mangled symbols required per layout; actual wrong-header link failure gate required. No universal LTO claim.
dispositions.cleanup: Keep normal exit destructors and include them in whole-process wall time; deliberately leaking registry for benchmark speed rejected.
dispositions.tls_cache: Single cached span/polarity kept; two-entry cache deferred until measured alternation warrants it.
dispositions.uniform_polarity: Bitvector retained as requested. Uniform source-mode bool could replace it in a future measured variant.

limitations: Process-lifetime registry is a single-file benchmark prototype; spectrum reclamation and bounded multi-file arena lifetime remain future work.
Input snapshots and caller filtered map remain retained; no early-input-release gain claimed.
Public LogMzPeak retains old 32-byte value semantics; pipeline InternalLogMzPeak changes container/API element type.
No hardware cache-miss counters collected in these native timings.

source_state: Frozen source manifests identify measured code; added benchmark documentation and CHANGELOG do not alter production source.
